get.summary: An Organisation that belongs to the public sector according to a legal framework, regardless of the level of government at which that framework is in force.
get.description: The public and semi-public organisations that can be classified as public sector are referred to in European Directive 2003/98/EC as "public bodies" and defined as: "the State, regional or local authorities, bodies governed by public law, associations formed by one or more of such bodies or one or more of such bodies governed by public law". And a body governed by public law means 'any body which (a) has been established for the specific purpose of meeting needs in the general interest, not having an industrial or commercial character, and (b) has legal personality, and (c) the activities of which are financed, for the most part, by the State, regional or local authorities or by other bodies governed by public law,  either the management is subject to supervision by the latter, or more than half of the members of the administrative, managerial or supervisory board are appointed by the State, regional or local authorities or other bodies governed by public law.';
